all_routes.answer: At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.

Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.

all_routes.answer: Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.

all_routes.answer: Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.

all_routes.answer: In the UAE, the student residence visa is typically sponsored by the university or by a parent or relative who is a legal resident. It is valid for up to 12 months and renewed each year. The visa process usually starts with the sponsoring institution after admission, through the ICP portal or the GDRFA of the emirate.
